crossRefs.note: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
For he didn’t leave to Jehoahaz of the people any more than fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen…
Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his foot in righteousness? He hands over nations to him and…
Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them…
You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in…
I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the…
For Yahweh’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down…
They shall be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle; and they shall fight, because Yahweh is with…
You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says…

parallels.note: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.

translations.web: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
translations.bsb: I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.
translations.kjv: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
translations.asv: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind; I did cast them out as the mire of the streets.
